pay_detail: Paid. The city page says the 2024 summer placement was a six-week, 105-hour paid work experience. Pay rate not stated.
name: Youth Employment Services (YES)
org: City of Champaign with Champaign Unit 4 School District
what_you_do: Unit 4 students are placed with local employers for a six-week summer work experience. The program also supports students during the school year.
deadline_text: The city page does not post 2027 dates. It says YES places students with local employers for six weeks each summer.
how_to_apply: Apply through the Youth Employment Services page on the Champaign Unit 4 School District website (linked from the city page). That school page would not load for us, so confirm the steps with the district.
notes: Only for students who attend Champaign Unit 4 schools. Illinois work permit rules were not checked.
